name: Graphwalks parents >128k
description: A graph reasoning benchmark that evaluates language models' ability to find parent nodes in graphs with context length over 128k tokens, testing long-context reasoning and graph structure understanding.
reputation: A niche long-context reasoning benchmark with limited public adoption, mainly used to probe graph-structure understanding at very large context lengths.
notes: Likely susceptible to contamination because it is a synthetic-style reasoning benchmark; results may vary strongly with prompt format and long-context handling.
